evidence.detail: Per-season preaggregation of num_decks, num_people, num_matches, num_competitions etc. already exists in _season_stats table
Existing Past Seasons page surfaces this data but as a plain per-season list, not a trend chart or growth dashboard
No growth metrics dashboard or charting route exists; 'new players' metric (first-time players per season) is not computed anywhere

triage.notes: Most aggregate data is already collected; the main work is building a new page with chart visualizations (season-over-season trend lines), computing the 'new players' metric (persons first seen in each season), and deciding which metrics are most useful to highlight.
